title: 按键控制流水灯
goal: 掌握数字输入的读取方法：按键低电平有效、软件消抖、按住运行/松开停止的控制逻辑。
doc:
实验平台（虚实结合）：本课程实物实验采用 STC89C52RC 最小系统板（京东开发板）与 STM32F407 最小系统板（京东开发板）。 本虚拟仿真实验基于上述最小系统板构建，可灵活扩展外设（LED、按键、上拉电阻、蜂鸣器、矩阵键盘、数码管、LCD1602、串口适配器等），是实物实验的有益补充——虚实结合、线上线下实验类似但不完全重复。

实验原理

按键一端接 P2.0，另一端接 GND；R1 为外部上拉电阻（10kΩ 接 VCC），保证松开时引脚稳定为高电平（读出 1）。按下按键时引脚被拉到低电平（读到 0）。 从原理图即可判断：松开=高（上拉），按下=低（直通 GND）。所以判断按键用 if (P2_0 == 0)。机械按键按下/弹起会有抖动，用 10ms 延时消抖。

步进节奏由 delay_ms(500) 决定：每 500ms 换下一个灯。注意 delay_ms 的内层循环按 11.0592MHz、12T 标定（内层 250+52 次 ≈ 1ms）——若沿用常见的 92 次写法，一次实际只有约 0.3ms，流水灯会"一闪而过"；而把常数直接改成 307 又会退化成 16 位比较、慢 2~3 倍。

按键功能

按键引脚作用触发方式
K1P2.0运行键——按住才流水，松开全灭（记住当前灯位，下次接着走）按住有效（电平）
K2P2.1方向键——切换流水方向（D1→D8 ⇄ D8→D1）按一下切换（边沿触发 + 10ms 消抖）

接线表

元件连接
K1 按键P2.0 ↔ GND（R1 上拉至 VCC）—— P2.0 在芯片右侧偏下，走线避开 LED
K2 按键P2.1 ↔ GND（R2 上拉至 VCC）
D1~D8P1.0 ~ P1.7（同实验1）

实验步骤

  1. 编译下载后，用鼠标按住 K1：流水灯每 500ms 前进一位；松开全灭
  2. 按一下 K2 再松开：方向切换为 D8→D1；再按一下切回 D1→D8（按一下即可，不必按住）
  3. 按住 K1 时按 K2：下一个灯就反向，可随时来回切
  4. 阅读代码，理解「运行键 K1 + 方向键 K2」分工、边沿触发与 10ms 消抖

思考

1. 为什么判断按键用 == 0 而不是 == 1？
2. 若想"按一下只移动一位"（而非连续流动），程序应怎么改？
checklist: P2.0/P2.1 各接一只独立按键（另一脚接 GND）和 10kΩ 上拉电阻
8 个 LED 接 P1.0–P1.7（K 脚统一接 GND）
不按键时 LED 全灭；按住 K1 流水运行
按一下 K2 能切换流水方向（D1→D8 ⇄ D8→D1）
编译 0 错误，烧录运行验证两种按键行为
goalEn: Reading digital inputs: active-low buttons, software debouncing, run-while-pressed / stop-on-release control logic.
docEn:
Experiment platform (virtual–physical): the physical labs in this course use the STC89C52RC minimal system board (JD.com) and the STM32F407 minimal system board (JD.com). This virtual experiment is built on the same boards and can be extended with peripherals (LEDs, buttons, pull-up resistors, buzzer, matrix keypad, 7-segment displays, LCD1602, UART adapter, etc.) — a useful complement to the physical labs: similar but not identical.

Principle

One side of the button goes to P2.0, the other to GND; R1 is an external pull-up (10kΩ to VCC) so the pin reads 1 when released. Pressing pulls the pin low (reads 0). You can tell from the schematic: released = high (pull-up), pressed = low (straight to GND). That is why the code tests if (P2_0 == 0). Mechanical buttons bounce on press/release; debounce with a 10ms delay.

The step rate comes from delay_ms(500): one LED every 500 ms. The inner loop of delay_ms is calibrated for 11.0592 MHz / 12T at 250 + 52 inner iterations ≈ 1 ms — the common 92-iteration version is only about 0.3 ms (the chaser flashes past), while writing 307 directly degrades to a 16-bit compare and becomes 2–3× slower.

Button functions

ButtonPinRoleTrigger
K1P2.0Run — the chaser moves while K1 is held; all LEDs off on release (current position kept)level (hold)
K2P2.1Direction — toggles D1→D8 ⇔ D8→D1edge-triggered, 10 ms debounce

Wiring

PartConnection
K1 buttonP2.0 ↔ GND (R1 pull-up to VCC) — P2.0 is on the right side of the chip, lower down; route around the LEDs
K2 buttonP2.1 ↔ GND (R2 pull-up to VCC)
D1–D8P1.0 ~ P1.7 (same as Lab 1)

Steps

  1. After flashing, hold K1 with the mouse: the chaser advances one LED every 500 ms; release to turn all off
  2. Click K2 once and release: the direction switches to D8→D1; click again to switch back (a single click is enough)
  3. Clicking K2 while K1 is held flips the direction on the next step
  4. Read the code to see the split between the run key (K1) and the direction key (K2), edge detection and 10 ms debounce

Reflection

1. Why test == 0 instead of == 1?
2. How would you change the program so "one press moves one step" instead of running continuously?
checklistEn: A button + 10kΩ pull-up on each of P2.0/P2.1 (other side to GND)
All LEDs off when no button is pressed; the chaser runs while K1 is held
K2 toggles the direction on a single click (D1→D8 ⇄ D8→D1)
Build with 0 errors; verify both button behaviors after flashing
